fonts.display: 'Denim Ink', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Courier New', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Forest Canopy
palette.role: Primary page background, nav strip, footer canvas — the dominant surface that defines the entire brand atmosphere

palette.name: Vault Floor
palette.role: Card surfaces, recessed panels, elevated content blocks within the forest canvas

palette.name: Canopy Mid
palette.role: Elevated card variant, highlighted surface tier above the base canvas

palette.name: Lime Phosphor
palette.role: Primary action buttons, active state indicators, illustrative highlight panels, brand-accent moments — the sole chromatic signal in the system

palette.name: Moss Border
palette.role: Hairline dividers, list separators, subtle table borders — barely-there green-on-green rules

palette.name: Fern
palette.role: Secondary accent strokes, table emphasis borders, mid-saturation green used sparingly for variety within lime contexts

palette.name: White
palette.role: Body text, heading text, icon strokes, ghost button borders, link colors, input fields — the only neutral light tone in the palette
